INVALID_MFA_CODE: Invalid code. Try the current code or a recovery code.
CHALLENGE_EXPIRED: The verification expired. Start again from sign-in.
ACTIVATION_CODE_INVALID: The activation code is not valid, has expired or was already used.
PASSWORD_TOO_WEAK: The password does not meet the rules.
SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission to do this.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
NO_ACTIVE_MEMBERSHIP: You do not have access to this customer.
TENANT_SUSPENDED: This customer is suspended: contact whoever runs Mercurio.
COMPANY_NOT_ACCESSIBLE: You do not have access to this company.
MFA_ALREADY_ENROLLED: Two-factor authentication is already set up.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is unavailable. Try again shortly.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Try again shortly.
NETWORK: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
PARTY_VAT_TAKEN: An active party already has this VAT number.
ITEM_CODE_TAKEN: This code is already used by another item, archived ones included.
EDIT_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this record in the meantime.
ARCHIVED: The record is archived: restore it to change it.
MODULE_NOT_ENABLED: This feature is not enabled for this customer.
STOCK_INSUFFICIENT: Not enough available stock: some lines take out more than there is that orders have not reserved.
STOCK_RESERVED: The count is below what orders have reserved: release reservations from the orders first, then record the adjustment.
DOCUMENT_HAS_ORIGIN: An order recorded this document: undo it from the order.
WAREHOUSE_NOT_EMPTY: The warehouse holds goods: it can be archived only when empty.
WAREHOUSE_CODE_TAKEN: Code already used by another warehouse of this company.
ALREADY_REVERSED: The document has already been reversed.
CANNOT_REVERSE_REVERSAL: A reversal cannot be reversed: record a new document.
DOCUMENT_ID_REUSED: The document changed after it was first sent: reload the page and start again.
ORDER_NOT_FOUND: Order not found in this company.
ORDER_NOT_DRAFT: The order is already confirmed and no longer changes. To correct it, cancel it and duplicate it.
ORDER_NOT_OPEN: The order is not open: it is a draft, already shipped or received, or cancelled.
ORDER_HAS_FULFILMENTS: The order already has receipts or shipments: close the rest instead of cancelling it.
NOTHING_TO_FULFIL: Enter at least one quantity above zero.
NOTHING_TO_CLOSE: There is nothing left to close.
FULFILMENT_ALREADY_REVERSED: This record has already been undone.
FULFILMENT_NOT_FOUND: Record not found in this order.

validation.passwordsDifferent: The two passwords do not match.
validation.savedRecovery: Confirm that you saved the codes.
validation.NOT_ALLOWED: Not used for this kind or this country.
validation.PARTY_NEEDS_ROLE: Choose at least one role: customer, supplier or both.
validation.PARTY_NEEDS_IDENTIFIER: A VAT number or a tax code is needed.
validation.PARTY_VAT_TAKEN: Another active party has this VAT number.
validation.VAT_NUMBER_INVALID: Invalid VAT number: 11 digits with the right check digit.
validation.TAX_CODE_PERSON: Invalid tax code: 16 characters with the right check character.
validation.TAX_CODE_COMPANY: Invalid tax code: 11 digits with the right check digit.
validation.SDI_CODE_INVALID: Invalid recipient code: 7 letters or digits.
validation.ITEM_CODE_INVALID: Invalid code: letters, digits and - . _ /, up to 35.
validation.ITEM_CODE_TAKEN: Code already used by another item.
validation.decimal: Invalid amount: use a dot for decimals, up to 4 (e.g. 12.50).
validation.WAREHOUSE_CODE_INVALID: Invalid code: letters, digits and -, at most 10.
validation.WAREHOUSE_CODE_TAKEN: Code already used by another warehouse.
validation.WAREHOUSE_NOT_FOUND: Warehouse not found in this company.
validation.SAME_WAREHOUSE: Choose a warehouse other than the origin.
validation.PARTY_WRONG_ROLE: The party does not have the required role (supplier or customer).
validation.ITEM_NOT_STOCK_MANAGED: Item not managed in stock (a service).
validation.ITEM_ARCHIVED: Archived item: it can only go out.
validation.QUANTITY_DECIMALS: Too many decimals for this unit of measure.
validation.quantity: Invalid quantity: use a dot for decimals.
validation.NO_DIFFERENCE: The counted quantity equals the stock: remove the line.
validation.DATE_IN_FUTURE: The date cannot be in the future.
validation.DATE_AFTER_DOCUMENT: Cannot be after the document date.
validation.QUANTITY_OVER_REMAINING: More than what is left on the line.
validation.PRICE_INVALID: Invalid price: use a dot for decimals, at most 4.
validation.DISCOUNT_INVALID: Invalid discount: 0 to 100, at most 2 decimals.
validation.REQUESTED_BEFORE_ORDER: Cannot be before the order date.
validation.NO_LINES: Add at least one line to confirm.
validation.ORDER_LINE_NOT_FOUND: Line not found in the order.
validation.ISSUE_DATE_BEFORE_LAST: Before the last document issued in the series: number and date grow together.
validation.TOTAL_NOT_POSITIVE: The total must be more than zero.
validation.CREDIT_OVER_INVOICED: More than is left to credit.
validation.CREDITED_LINE_NOT_FOUND: Line of the invoice not found.
validation.FULFILMENT_LINE_NOT_FOUND: Line of the shipment not found.
validation.FULFILMENT_LINE_QUANTITY_FIXED: The shipped quantity does not change.
validation.IBAN_REQUIRED: A bank transfer needs the company's IBAN.
validation.ALLOCATION_MISMATCH: The due dates settled must add up to the amount.
validation.ALLOCATION_OVER_DUE: More than is open on the due date.
validation.DUE_DATE_NOT_FOUND: Due date not found for this customer.
validation.DUE_DATE_WRONG_KIND: A payment settles invoices, a refund credit notes.
validation.BEFORE_DOCUMENT: Before the date of the document.
validation.ROLE_NAME_RESERVED: That is the name of a built-in role: choose another.
validation.ROLE_NAME_TAKEN: A role with this name already exists.
validation.PERMISSION_RESERVED: Managing people and roles stays with the Administrator.
validation.ROLE_PERMISSIONS_INCOMPLETE: Some permissions the chosen ones need are missing.
validation.MEMBERSHIP_EXISTS: This person already works on this customer.

COMPANY_DATA_INCOMPLETE: The company lacks data to issue the invoice: complete it in Company data.
CUSTOMER_DATA_INCOMPLETE: The customer lacks data to issue the invoice (address, tax identifier, SdI code or PEC): complete its record.
FULFILMENT_INVOICED: The shipment is in a draft or an invoice: take it out of the draft, or issue a credit note and record the return in the warehouse.
FULFILMENT_ALREADY_DRAFTED: The shipment is already in another draft invoice.
MIXED_CUSTOMERS: An invoice is for one customer: choose shipments of the same customer.
DRAFT_NOT_FOUND: Draft not found: it may have been issued or deleted.
NOT_AN_INVOICE: A credit note is made from an invoice only.
NOTHING_TO_CREDIT: Nothing is left to credit of this invoice.
PAYMENT_IS_REVERSAL: This undoes a payment: it cannot be undone.
NOT_A_SALE: Delivery notes print for sales only.
XML_DATA_INCOMPLETE: The FatturaPA file needs data that is missing: complete the customer or the company data.
MEMBERSHIP_EXISTS: This person already works on this customer.
MEMBERSHIP_NOT_FOUND: This person no longer works on this customer: reload the page.
MEMBER_SELF_CHANGE: Another administrator changes your role and companies.
LAST_ADMIN: The customer would be left without administrators: appoint another administrator first.
ACTIVATION_NOT_ALLOWED: The code for this person is not issued from here: they already have an account, or work for other customers too. They can sign in with their own credentials; recovering access takes whoever runs Mercurio.
USER_DISABLED: This account is disabled: ask whoever runs Mercurio.
ROLE_NOT_FOUND: The role no longer exists: reload the page.
ROLE_NAME_TAKEN: A role with this name already exists.
ROLE_IN_USE: Someone still holds this role: give them another role before archiving it.
COMPANY_ID_REUSED: This company was recorded with different data: reload the page.
COMPANY_VAT_TAKEN: A company with this VAT number already exists.
NOT_PLATFORM_OPERATOR: This area is for platform operators only.
TENANT_SLUG_EXISTS: This identifier is already used by another customer.
TENANT_STATUS_UNCHANGED: The customer is already in this state.
ALREADY_ADMIN: This person is already an administrator of the customer.
ADMIN_PROMOTION_REQUIRED: This person already works for the customer with another role.
INVALID_SLUG: The identifier uses lowercase letters, digits and single dashes (up to 50 characters).
INVALID_NAME: The name is required (up to 200 characters).
INVALID_COMPANY_NAME: The company name is required (up to 200 characters).
MODULE_DEPENDENCY_MISSING: A chosen module needs another module that is not on.
MODULE_REQUIRED_BY_OTHER: Another active module needs this one: switch that off first.
